gap_notes: Valens I.1 is a topical/significator catalog (sect, colour, taste, body parts), not Ptolemy/Lilly elemental qualities. Do not backfill heat/cold/dry/moist from Valens, and do not average catalogs into function.

Valens I.1 attests convertibility (effects vary with zodiac and other stars) without a native cold/dry quality. Native-quality conflict (Ptolemy alternate dry/moist vs Lilly melancholy) is not resolved.

Native-quality conflict: Ptolemy makes Mercury alternate dryness and moisture with equal vigour; Lilly says of his own nature he is cold and dry / melancholy, then takes the planet he joins. Do not collapse to one elemental lemma.
Object-level themes mix compared and school_specific lemmas. Per-lemma evidence_tier stays in this ledger; knowledge-object schema is not expanded for that.
Layer 1 requires positive_expression; it is filled from Lilly well-dignified manners only until a second school class is compared. Valens is still source_class=classical.

Watters 2003 is modern general practical synthesis, not Houlding/Lilly traditional and not Hand. Parked source_class=professional (classification gap; schema has no modern_general_practical). school_specific only.
Research runtime-eligibility flags are not a schema field. Body/health/fertility/medical rows stay ledger-only. Not copied into object.domains. Not runtime meaning. Planet-in-sign is Layer 5.
Watters orbit-period rows are astronomy-in-an-astrology-page, not Day Sources. Kept separate from symbolic solar-return / phase / menstrual readings on the same page.
Greene Inner Planets preview: Mercury via young-Hermes as spontaneity/openness to the unplanned. School_specific only. Do not average with Watters mind/curiosity or Ptolemy convertibility.

CORE cannot be scored. Watters is school_specific modern practical, not Hand and not traditional. Greene Inner Planets Hermes-spontaneity is a different category from Watters mind/curiosity. Do not treat more rows as consensus.
Hand Horoscope Symbols Ch.4 Mercury is identified; chapter body not opened this pass. Research-dump atoms not ingested. Do not average with Greene young-Hermes spontaneity.
Future reconciliation (do not rewrite now): Watters Mercury breadth-over-depth vs Hand Jupiter overview vs detail. Tension logged; Mercury rows unchanged.
